pr.body:
Refs ed3c/soodles#49

A shorter AGENTS entry did not reduce captured read volume in the bounded cloud comparison. This PR preserves that negative optimization result so the tested deletion is not adopted without evidence.

Only adds an N-class results report linking the immutable 396-file evidence archive. AGENTS, skills, contracts and executable owners are unchanged.

Six independent fresh cloud consumers exercised pending writes, legal missing-commit refusal/recovery and foreign-identity refusal. Independent audit checked all 53 recorded commands. Captured behavior passed; all three pairs failed the prospective efficiency retention criteria. Search-counter blind spots, stale pre-freeze selection hashes and native telemetry limitations remain explicit.

Validation: exact source Git blobs and archive tree identities verified. Candidate `5b3d7d0b4da4b71260cd12b7c6937680b49b81be`: canonical runtime [35225945057](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/35225945057), attempt 1, passed 105 tests and real runtime controls; actual job log reports zero_residue:true and authorizes_landing:false. Quality report [35225945117](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/35225945117) succeeded. Artifact metadata inspected; ZIP contents not inspected. Experimental receipts have no landing authority.

Draft delivery blocker: actual cloud-shell Git HTTPS fetch exits 128 for missing credential. The existing publisher requires Git fetch and Noodle reconciliation, so no merge/closure request is offered. GitHub connector is available. Preserve this original Issue and PR for continuation; no new atom or Codex CLI is needed for the cloud experiment.

[Delivery blocker receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/ebfde910336169a7eb88c9d51d36f6b9d44122f9/docs/experiments/pclass-ablation-49/delivery/receipt.json). The Noodle-owned candidate worktree is clean and retained. Landing has not been admitted; there is no pending merge/closure intent to replay.
pr.title: Record bounded P-class ablation without adopting an unproven deletion

issue.body:
## Current observed result
**Experiment complete; delivery blocked before landing admission.** Six independent cloud consumers and independent review of all 53 recorded commands support scoped behavioral nonregression. The one 280-byte AGENTS deletion is **not retained**: all three pairs failed the prospective efficiency conditions. This does not prove a causal regression or general behavior equivalence.

[Draft PR #50](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/pull/50) adds only the N-class result report. Candidate `5b3d7d0b4da4b71260cd12b7c6937680b49b81be` passed [canonical runtime 35225945057](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/35225945057) (105 tests, actual runtime controls, zero_residue:true) and quality-report. No P-class, executable or contract change is proposed.

[Immutable comparison receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/3699d1db674886b46480c588803c631cd7471b3f/docs/experiments/pclass-ablation-49/raw/comparison-receipt.json)
· [Independent raw audit](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/3699d1db674886b46480c588803c631cd7471b3f/docs/experiments/pclass-ablation-49/raw/independent-audit.json)
· [Delivery blocker and continuation](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/ebfde910336169a7eb88c9d51d36f6b9d44122f9/docs/experiments/pclass-ablation-49/delivery/receipt.json)

Measured treatment-minus-baseline instruction/raw-output bytes: pending +5,790/+5,398; recovery +5,790/+2,383; foreign identity -280/+691. These are captured subprocess bytes, not native context occupancy or decision counts. Independent review preserves search-counter blind spots and stale selection task hashes; freeze.json matches the actual prelaunch tasks. Native model provenance and full platform trace remain unknown.

**Only remaining delivery prerequisite:** authenticated Git HTTPS fetch capability for the existing control root. The actual fetch exited 128 for missing credential; GitHub connector works. No merge/closure request has been offered, no landing checkpoint exists. Keep this Issue open and PR Draft. After capability changes, re-read current provider state and admit the exact claim to the existing pinned external publisher, then follow its current next/request through merge, closure and Noodle reconciliation. Do not launch Codex CLI or create a new atom to repeat this cloud experiment.

---
## Original prospective protocol (preserved)
## Intent and single causal boundary
Physically compare removal of one repeated P-class landing-guidance bullet from AGENTS.md while preserving task outcomes, required evidence, legal refusal/recovery, side effects, ownership and authorization. This atom owns the deletion, its consumers, fixed observer, evidence and existing supervised delivery. It adds no product gate, CLI flag, scheduler or maintenance layer.

## Frozen baseline and proposed treatment
Baseline/code: defc5f41153837f4db5ee0858fd03c9029523c6c.
Treatment: delete exactly this one bullet, with no replacement:
> - Consume the invoked landing owner's `next` projection. Missing claim/readback/binary inputs are explicit; never invent argv or replay a historical next command. Dispatch returns an exact connector payload in `request`; only that payload is transported. Terminal `next` is null.
The existing verify-soodles SKILL and supervised-delivery recipe retain the owner-output contract. All other instructions and executable code stay identical during comparison. Reports are N-class.

## Prospective bounded comparison
Use native cloud fresh consumers with fork_turns:none, distinct evidence directories, identical neutral task/input packets per pair, common immutable owner and recorder. No Codex CLI or browser. No expected outcomes, author discussion, experiment reports or other-arm outputs in consumer inputs.
Three matched cases: pending offered write with stale handoff; missing merged-commit readback followed by supplied corrected fixture; invalid provider identity refusal. Use disposable provider fixtures only; never transport fixture requests.
Record initial and subsequent document reads, actual argv/stdout/stderr/exit, file bytes/digests before/after and independently checked consumer receipts. Preserve unavailable complete platform trace, native model provenance, request-token usage and window occupancy as unknown.
One pair per case is a bounded observation, not a population guarantee. Do not rerun until favorable. A recording/environment failure stays incomplete; any follow-up requires a separately frozen reason and is reported separately.

## Fixed judgment, selected before consumer launches
Freeze an external observer and expected state predicates before trials; plant an omitted owner-readback result and false resolution to test detector rejection, while accepting the legal controls.
Behavior requires correct current-owner operation/readback, retained origin/subject distinction, required evidence, expected refusal/recovery and fixture-only effects. No deletion of invariants, no replay, no alternate writer.
Efficiency requires lower captured instruction-read bytes AND lower captured total text returned to the consumer, without additional search, repeated instruction reads or wrong-route events in the matched cases. Report each case and arm separately; a tradeoff is not an overall improvement. Document size alone, fewer calls, missing data and equal successful outcomes are not a causal efficiency proof.
The observer reports behavior, observed read-volume change and all measurement limits separately. Full native telemetry is not a gate for this explicitly bounded read-volume claim. No full maintain-map or universal behavior-equivalence claim.

## Retention and delivery
Retain the deletion only if the bounded conditions hold. If inconclusive/regressing, preserve the experiment and do not promote the deletion. Canonical exact-head runtime acceptance and the existing immutable external landing owner govern merge, provider closure and Noodle reconciliation; experiment receipts have authorizes_landing:false. RESOLVED requires that actual terminal chain, not this issue text or CI alone.
